What we measured at Hampton Inn & Suites Grandville Grand Rapids South

Google Hotels listed Hampton Inn & Suites Grandville Grand Rapids South as a 3-star hotel. Its all-in going rate, $115 a night, was the 4th lowest of the 9 hotels with an all-in going rate on our Grand Rapids page (they ranged from $100 to $222), and the 4th lowest of the 8 there listed as 3-star. Taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added $26 (29%) to its before-tax going rate of $89, the highest share of the 9 hotels with both prices on our Grand Rapids page (they ranged from 17% to 29%); our data does not split it into taxes and fees. 1 of the 14 booking sites listed exactly the going rate. The highest, $128 on Super.com and Hotels In America, was 25% above the lowest. 6 of the 14 sites named a room on their lowest listing: Hotels.com, Expedia.com, the hotel's own site, Travelocity.com and 2 more. None of the 14 sites showed free cancellation on its lowest listing.

Questions about Hampton Inn & Suites Grandville Grand Rapids South prices

Which booking site listed the lowest price for Hampton Inn & Suites Grandville Grand Rapids South?

On September 29, 2026, for Nov 3 to Nov 5, KAYAK.com and Hotelscombined.com tied for lowest of the 14 sites at $102 a night all-in, 11% below the going rate of $115. Prices change daily, so for your dates another site may have the lowest price. Before you book: Is KAYAK.com legit? Is Hotelscombined.com legit?

Was Hampton Inn & Suites Grandville Grand Rapids South cheaper on Booking.com or Expedia?

On September 29, 2026, for Nov 3 to Nov 5: Booking.com $115, Expedia.com $105 a night all-in. Expedia.com was $10 lower. Both were above the lowest price, $102 on KAYAK.com and Hotelscombined.com. How the two compare in general: Expedia vs Booking.com.

Was it cheaper to book Hampton Inn & Suites Grandville Grand Rapids South direct?

On September 29, 2026, for Nov 3 to Nov 5, the hotel's own site listed $105 a night all-in. 2 of the 14 sites listed it for less; the lowest was $102 on KAYAK.com and Hotelscombined.com, $3 under the hotel's own site. More on this: Booking.com vs booking direct.

How much did Hampton Inn & Suites Grandville Grand Rapids South prices differ between booking sites?

On September 29, 2026, for Nov 3 to Nov 5, the 14 sites we recorded ranged from $102 to $128 a night all-in, $26 apart. The going rate was $115.
